shared_elements: row of small repeated human-like figures
justification: Both are engraved surfaces showing schematic linear forms with horizontal divisions and a row of small repeated anthropomorphic figures, but A depicts a large boat-like vessel with oars/crew as an outline drawing filling the whole field, while B shows seated and standing human figures with offering tables, hieroglyph-like signs and a formal two-register composition. The shared features (rows of tiny figures, dividing lines) are generic to engraved imagery and no specific motif, posture or relationship corresponds.
